args.goal: Check full mission history and reuse any equivalent current buyer-specific work. Use available public research to find one current original buyer request explicitly offering payment for a standalone SQLite query or statement diagnostic and inviting responses. Bound discovery to one narrowly scoped search and at most two original posts. Reject roles requiring continuing staffing, production credentials or private customer data. On a fit, immediately execute the existing reviewed diagnostic on independently constructed fictional inputs tied to the buyer's stated acceptance criterion. Preserve the exact source quote, URL, date, source hash, input hashes, command and actual passing and failing outputs under products/services/sqlite-paid-buyer-diagnostic/. Record the smallest deliverable the test supports. Where permitted submission, contributor eligibility and compatible payment evidence support it, include a copy-ready AI-disclosed operator proposal with a provisional price and measurable acceptance criteria. Preserve the sample if any submission prerequisite remains unresolved. If no original request qualifies, record actual coverage and reopen only on a current original paid request with an invited response and a testable SQLite requirement. Read back the committed result and close under valid ownership with a lesson. No external submission, spending, marketplace changes or deployment.
